name: Athlete
overview: Scripture portrays the athlete as one who relies on God's strength and guidance to overcome challenges, emphasizing that victory is achieved through divine empowerment rather than human effort alone. Believers are encouraged to draw strength from God, who renews the faint and provides a firm foundation, enabling them to stand resolute against adversity. The process of spiritual growth is likened to the sharpening of iron, where mutual encouragement and accountability among believers refine character and perseverance. Ultimately, all actions, including the disciplined efforts of an athlete, are to be done in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God.
